description: Meridian Pay's active trust policy for the pay-android app, as stored in the control plane (kseal.v1.Policy). rules and risk_thresholds are JSON-encoded strings on the wire; they are expanded inline here for readability. policy_hash = sha256("meridian/payments-baseline/v12") = 62fdc9b7...; it is echoed in every telemetry event and decision so a record can be tied back to the exact policy that produced it.
notes: enforcement_mode STEP_UP means CRITICAL -> DENY, HIGH/MEDIUM -> STEP_UP, everything else ALLOW (see reference/fixtures/scenarios.json and server/shared/risk Decision). The thresholds shown are the kseal defaults; a tenant can tighten them per app. modules_enabled lists the 14 RASP probes the build runs; the five fraud-vector probes (screen_capture, overlay, accessibility, malicious_ime, remote_access) are Android-only.
